# monero_wallet_core_module — Monero Wallet Core

> In-process Monero wallet engine: wraps monero_c (wallet2 C ABI, LGPL-3.0, dynamically linked, built from source). Keys and the wallet password never leave this module.

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `startJob` | `startJob(kind: tstr, params: {tstr: any}) -> result` | Queue a long operation. |
| `jobStatus` | `jobStatus(jobId: tstr, receipt: tstr)` |  |
| `jobResult` | `jobResult(jobId: tstr, receipt: tstr) -> result` | The job's result, once. |
| `ackJob` | `ackJob(jobId: tstr, receipt: tstr) -> bool` | Forget a finished job. |
| `cancelJob` | `cancelJob(jobId: tstr, receipt: tstr) -> bool` | Cancel a queued job. |
| `status` | `status()` |  |
| `balance` | `balance(accountIndex: int) -> tstr` | Balances in ATOMIC UNITS as decimal strings (1 XMR = 1e12; a JSON number loses precision above 2^53). |
| `unlockedBalance` | `unlockedBalance(accountIndex: int) -> tstr` |  |
| `address` | `address(accountIndex: int, addressIndex: int) -> tstr` | The address at (account, index). |
| `subaddresses` | `subaddresses(accountIndex: int) -> [any]` | `[ { index, address } ]` for one account. |
| `createSubaddress` | `createSubaddress(accountIndex: int, label: tstr) -> result` | Add a subaddress to an account. |
| `setSubaddressLabel` | `setSubaddressLabel(accountIndex: int, addressIndex: int, label: tstr) -> result` | Rename (or clear, with an empty string) a subaddress label. |
| `history` | `history() -> [any]` | `[ { txid, direction: "in"¦"out", amount, fee, height, confirmations, timestamp, pending, failed, unlockTime, paymentId } ]`, amounts as decimal strings. |
| `addressValid` | `addressValid(addr: tstr, network: tstr) -> bool` | Whether `addr` is valid for `network` (mainnet¦stagenet¦testnet¦regtest). |
| `revealSeed` | `revealSeed(password: tstr) -> result` | The 25-word seed, after re-checking `password` against the open wallet's keys file. |
| `revealViewKey` | `revealViewKey(password: tstr) -> result` | The secret view key, same discipline as revealSeed(). |
| `listWallets` | `listWallets() -> [any]` | Wallet names present in this instance's wallets directory. |
| `walletExists` | `walletExists(name: tstr) -> bool` |  |
| `libraryVersion` | `libraryVersion()` |  |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `walletStateChanged` | `walletStateChanged(payloadJson: tstr)` | Emitted on every state transition with the same shape as status(). |
| `jobFinished` | `jobFinished(jobId: tstr, state: tstr)` | A ticket reached a terminal state: `state` is "done" or "failed". |
